text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as a single function, while integration tests make sure that different parts of the system work well together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and improve the design. Good tests also give developers confidence. When tests pass, the team knows that changes have not broken existing features. As a result, they can update the software more safely and quickly. In short, testing saves time, reduces stress, and leads to better quality products.
